# Best Practices

Development standards, patterns, and recommendations for Rayls applications.

---

## Overview

This guide establishes best practices for developing secure, maintainable Rayls applications.

## Key Principles

| Principle | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| Security First | Always validate inputs and handle failures |
| Atomic Operations | Use atomic transfers for multi-step operations |
| Minimal Trust | Verify cross-chain messages cryptographically |
